# YOKESH.KS

YOKESH.KS is a Full Stack AI Engineer building intelligent systems and scalable web applications. This site shares practical work in AI, full-stack development, SaaS, and engineering leadership.

## Sections

- [Home](https://www.yokesh.in) — Overview of projects, experience, skills, and latest writing.
- [Blog](https://www.yokesh.in/blog) — Articles on AI systems, React, TypeScript, Node.js, and production engineering.
- [Experience](https://www.yokesh.in/experience) — Professional timeline and roles.
- [Projects](https://www.yokesh.in/projects) — Portfolio of shipped products and experiments.
- [Snippets](https://www.yokesh.in/snippets) — Code guides and implementation notes.
- [Memories](https://www.yokesh.in/memories) — Milestones and event highlights.
- [Resources](https://www.yokesh.in/resources) — Curated tools and platforms for developers.
- [Jobs](https://www.yokesh.in/jobs) — Curated job platforms and resume builders.
